messages:
zoe_f: Heads-up — found 3 customers with duplicate refunds in NetSuite after yesterday's Stripe replay. Looks like retry replay logic applied refunds twice when webhook idempotency token was missing.

omar: Oof. Any logs/IDs? Are these from the payment-failure-replay or manual retries?

oze_f: Sample log: ```2026-07-08T02:12:10Z ERROR refund-processor: stripe_event=evt_r_7Zx idempotency_key=null processed=2026-07-08T02:11:58Z action=apply_refund result=applied```

ozar: (typo) sorry, that should be zoe_f. The stripe event shows no idempotency_key in payload; consumer fell back to processed_ts dedupe which failed during a double-replay.

rachel_fin: Which customers and exposure? We need totals before any comms.

oze_f: Affected: cus_112, cus_119, cus_121. Gross refunded twice totaling ~$1,340; NetSuite created two refund memos for each. I've exported CSV to the private sheet (internal).

omar: Root cause hypothesis: webhook consumer expects `idempotency_key` header from our webhook proxy but proxy omits it on certain retry paths. Fixing consumer to use stripe_event_id as dedupe primary should be safer.

infra-bot: nightly-summary 2026-07-08T04:05:00Z - processed=3,120 failed=5 dlq=2 replayed_events=18

omar: Plan: (1) hotfix consumer to prefer stripe_event_id-based idempotency and ignore null header (2) run targeted NS cleanup script to void duplicate refund memos (3) add metric `billing.duplicate_refund_count` and alert. I'll own 1+2.

rachel_fin: Please hold customer notifications until we reconcile and confirm corrected invoices. Finance will prepare messaging if needed.

omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/589 "refunds: use stripe_event_id for idempotency fallback". Includes unit tests simulating proxy header loss. @zoe_f please review the cleanup plan.

zoe_f: Reviewing. Also recommend adding test that replays the same stripe_event with null header twice to ensure consumer is safe.

deploy-bot: Deployed pr-589 to staging 2026-07-08T07:40:20Z. smoke tests passed.

omar: Ran staging cleanup dry-run: `./tools/cleanup_dup_refunds --csv staging-diff.csv --dry-run` — no accidental changes. Scheduling live cleanup 2026-07-09T01:15Z.

rachel_fin: Finance validated dry-run. Live cleanup approved; sales looped for any enterprise accounts.

omar: Live cleanup completed 2026-07-09T01:40Z — removed duplicate memos and posted reconciliations for 3 customers. No net customer credits outstanding. Posting final diff to the sheet.

rachel_fin: Verified. Closing loop. Follow-ups: (a) add proxy header validation and fallback in proxy (b) alert `billing.duplicate_refund_count > 0` to page. Filing FIN-827.

zoe_f: Thanks team. Adding postmortem note and adding integration test that replays retry bursts through the proxy. :white_check_mark:
